title: Version 17.14.14
body_markdown:
*Released September 9th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Symbols download no longer working | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Symbols-download-no-longer-working/10936162) |
| Fixed an issue with the value category of member accesses. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Class-members-arrays-element-is-not-an/10908213) |
| Fixed an issue with the value category of arrays. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/cl-Preview-fails-to-properly-determine-a/10907452) |
| Fixed an ICE related to an incorrectly determined value category of an array. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/After-updating-VS2022-to-1714-C-compi/10905664) |
| Fixed an issue where MSBuild would produce an internal error instead of reporting a build message when glob expansion failed. |  |
| .NET runtime is updated to 8.0.20 and 9.0.9, and .NET SDK to 9.0.305 |  |
| Extension update in VS 17.14 | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Extension-update-in-VS-1714/10904555) |
| GitHub Copilot Chat window auto-scrolls to latest generated word, preventing reading from top during response generation | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/GitHub-Copilot-Chat-window-in-Visual-Stu/10950911) |
| Configure Code Coverage Views fails | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Configure-Code-Coverage-VIews-fails/10919819) |
| Agent: total changes popup remains in chat window, cannot dismiss | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Agent:-total-changes-popup-remains-in-ch/10940565) |
